title: Big Bear Roars Again: Runners Take On the HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB Americas Major
claims: Cody Poskin won the 2026 100M in 16:46:21 by more than 36 minutes; Alex Proctor was second in 17:23:05 and Max Jolliffe third in 18:15:45.
Nichole Abma won the women's 100M in 20:43:40, Madeline Wighardt was second in 22:05:50 and Charlotte Saunders third in 22:39:31.

The 100K men's podium was Jose Angel Fernandez Jimenez 8:33:09, Gavin Prior 8:35:40 and Stephen Kersh 8:59:04; the women's podium was Lotti Brinks 10:15:44, Becca Bramley 10:25:04 and Lindsay Allison 10:28:08.

The 50K men's podium was Cole Campbell 3:20:42, Miquel Corbera Rubio 3:23:15 and Cade Michael 3:27:02; the women's podium was Anna Gibson 3:59:13, Carmen Graves 4:04:12 and Elizabeth O'Connor 4:06:30.
Joachim Cassel (1:38:24) and Tabor Scholl-Hemming (1:46:09) won the 21K; Juan Pablo Aguilar Fontalvo (50:02) and Charlotte Berrington (1:00:11) won the 10K.
The event supported 31 women runners from underrepresented groups in their preparation for the weekend.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 直读组委会赛后新闻稿；100K/50K/21K/10K 名次以此为一级来源。
